notes: Every existing constant is cited by file:line. New values are marked "status": "new".

blind_readme_quality_review_recovery.note: 3000 exactly matches the requirement's stated blind-quality budget; no new constant required.

factual_readme_plan_review_recovery.recovery_override_source: run_grounded_role(max_attempts_override=2) -- same call as normal separated path, no change needed
factual_readme_plan_review_recovery.note: 6000 exactly matches the requirement's stated factual-review budget; no new constant required.

request_ceiling.applies_to: the assembled merged_readme_review message list, pre-flight, before client.analyze()
request_ceiling.token_estimate_method: len(utf8_bytes) / 4, documented heuristic -- no tokenizer is vendored in this repo; matches the requirement's own "approximately" framing
request_ceiling.on_exceed: skip the normal merged call entirely (counts as 0 normal calls); route directly to two-facet recovery, each independently subject to the same ceiling
request_ceiling.calibration_caveat: heuristic; recommend recording actual byte size in every QwenReviewRecoveryReceiptV1 even on success, to calibrate this ceiling against real traffic before it is tightened or relaxed

per_call_hard_timeout_seconds.source: default timeout=90 on every Live*ReviewClient constructor, src/readme_agent/llm/reviewer_client.py (lines 32, 58, 84, 110, 138, 173, 218)

physical_call_ceilings.status: new (derived from existing per-role attempt constants)
worst_case_breakdown: 1 x merged_readme_review (fails or is skipped by the request ceiling)
up to 2 x blind_readme_quality_review_recovery (initial + 1 compact grounding retry)
up to 2 x factual_readme_plan_review_recovery (initial + 1 compact grounding retry)
